home.title: Decentralized Group Savings for Everyone
home.subtitle: SoroSave brings the traditional rotating savings model (ajo, susu, chit fund) to the Stellar blockchain. Trustless, transparent, and accessible.

steps.1_desc: Set contribution amount, cycle length, and max members. You become the admin.
steps.2_desc: Share the group link. Members join until the group is full or the admin starts it.
steps.3_desc: Every member contributes the fixed amount each round. Smart contract enforces rules.
steps.4_desc: Each round, one member receives the full pot. Continues until everyone has received.

features.trustless_desc: Smart contracts enforce contributions and payouts. No middleman needed.
features.transparent_desc: All transactions are on-chain. Every member can verify the group state.
features.low_cost_desc: Built on Soroban (Stellar). Transaction fees are a fraction of a cent.

footer.tagline: Open-source decentralized group savings protocol on Soroban.
